policy.name: Meghalaya Industrial and Investment Promotion Policy (MIIPP), 2024, as amended 2025; registration extended to 31.03.2027
policy.order_no: No.IND.15/2024/82 dated 14.03.2024; Amendment No.IND.15/2026/Pt/147 dated 09.12.2025 (Gazette Extraordinary No.206, 10.12.2025); Extension No IND.15/2024/Pt.I/5 dated 10.09.2026

zones.priority: Priority Sector units (clause 2.4 as amended 2025: incl. item 21 'Manufacturing (other than negative sectors)', textiles, agri-allied, bamboo, bio-fuels, automobiles/EVSE, ESDM + original items 1-16)

zone_lookup: Not geographic. Sector class per clause 2.4 of MIIPP 2024 as amended by Gazette No.206 of 10.12.2025 (amendment item 2); negative list Annexure A.

schemes.name: MIIPP 2024 State Capital Investment Incentive
schemes.notes: 30% of P&M cost; cap Rs 10 crore Priority Sector, Rs 8 crore non-priority. New and expanding units, once per unit, one unit per applicant; physical verification. Min investment: manufacturing Rs 1 crore P&M (3.1.2); micro Rs 10 lakh in P&M + factory building (3.1.4 as amended 2025; building counts as P&M for micro, 3.1.5). Amendment 2025 (No.IND.15/2026/Pt/147, 09.12.2025) added 'Manufacturing (other than negative sectors)' to Priority Sectors (clause 2.4, item 21), so practically all eligible manufacturing units get Priority rates. Per amended para 5.1(ii) (Amendment 2025): where UNNATI 2024 or other GoI scheme overlaps, only the DIFFERENCE between State and GoI incentive is eligible. Since UNNATI CII is 30% (Zone A) / 50% (Zone B), state top-up is nil for most units; mainly useful where UNNATI cap (Rs 5/7.5 cr) is exceeded or unit is not UNNATI-registered. Registration window extended to 31.03.2027 (Notification No IND.15/2024/Pt.I/5 dated 10.09.2026). Max benefit per unit Rs 100 crore across all components.

schemes.name: MIIPP 2024 State Interest Subvention Incentive
schemes.notes: 5% p.a. Priority Sector (4% non-priority) for max 7 consecutive years on term loan for P&M; loan principal up to Rs 250 crore; on disbursed amount; SCB/RBI-registered FIs; disbursement after commercial production. Per amended para 5.1(ii) (Amendment 2025): where UNNATI 2024 or other GoI scheme overlaps, only the DIFFERENCE between State and GoI incentive is eligible. (UNNATI CIS 3% Zone A / 5% Zone B => state top-up 2 pts in Zone A districts, nil in Zone B).

schemes.name: MIIPP 2024 SGST reimbursement
schemes.notes: Keys are SECTOR classes, not zones. NEW units only: 100% of net SGST (SGST paid less ITC), excl. exports, for 15 yrs (priority) / 10 yrs (non-priority) from commercial production or till policy validity (20.12.2034), ceiling 150% / 100% of eligible P&M value; paid at max 1/10th of total entitlement per FY with carry-forward. If SGST reimbursed under UNNATI MSLI, only balance claimable. Amendment 2025 added 99% MVAT/CST remission for 7 yrs (non-GST goods).

other_benefits: Special category (PwD etc.) top-up: micro +10% on factory building & P&M; small +5% of P&M up to Rs 50 lakh (para 3.4.4).
Transport subsidy (M&S): actual intra-state transport cost up to Rs 15 lakh/yr for 4 yrs (priority) / Rs 10 lakh for 3 yrs (para 3.4.5).
Green: rainwater harvesting 50% up to Rs 2 lakh (M&S); wastewater recycling 50% up to Rs 5 lakh (medium); water audit 75% up to Rs 1 lakh; zero discharge 50% up to Rs 5 lakh (medium) (para 3.4.6).
Power: DG/RE sets for M&S 50% conventional up to Rs 10 lakh / 75% RE up to Rs 50 lakh (as amended 2025); 11kV line drawal 100% up to Rs 10 lakh; service connection 50% up to Rs 2 lakh (para 3.4.7).
EPF: 100% employer contribution for 3 yrs (+1 yr women), domicile employees, max Rs 1,800/month (para 3.4.8).
No electricity-duty exemption, per-unit power tariff subsidy or certification reimbursement found in MIIPP 2024.
